name: Progress M-61
about: Progress M-61 (2007-033A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 2007 Aug  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2007 Aug 10), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
